contributions.anchor: Column A 'Total this Period' line 1 TOTAL CONTRIBUTIONS RECEIVED (1,740.00) on the SUMMARY PAGE, which on this filing is bound LAST (p4, located by its printed heading 'SUMMARY PAGE'); the same 1,740.00 is Schedule A's own printed 'Subtotal for this page' AND its 'Total Contributions Received (Sum of subtotals from all Schedule A pages)', and it is repeated at summary line 4 'Total Contributions Received (From Line 1 Column A)'
contributions.detail: 4 Schedule A rows sum to 120.00 + 250.00 + 250.00 + 1120.00 = 1,740.00 exactly = the schedule's printed page subtotal = its printed total = the cover's promoted PER-PERIOD cell (Column A). THE SUM CLOSES ONLY WITH IN-KIND INCLUDED: rows 1 and 4 are marked '(IN-KIND)' by the filer in the Amount column and total 1,240.00, so a monetary-only reading gives 500.00 and fails by 1,240.00. Column B 'Year-to-Date Total' prints 12,161.17 and is NEVER summed as an increment (utah is a per-period regime). The cover ladder independently corroborates: line 3 beginning 956.80 + line 4 1,740.00 = line 5 subtotal 2,696.80, minus line 6 expenditures 2,696.80 = line 7 balance at close, written as a SLASHED ZERO (0 under the zero-glyph ruling).

expenditures.anchor: Column A 'Total this Period' line 2 TOTAL EXPENDITURES MADE (2,696.80) on the p4 SUMMARY PAGE, equal to Schedule B's own printed 'Subtotal for this page' 2,696.80 and its printed 'Total Expenditures (Sum of subtotals from all Schedule B pages)' 2,696.80, and repeated at summary line 6
expenditures.detail: 5 Schedule B rows sum to 120.00 + 29.05 + 15.00 + 1120.00 + 1412.75 = 2,696.80 exactly = the printed page subtotal = the printed total = the cover's Column A line 2. AGAIN THE SUM CLOSES ONLY WITH IN-KIND: rows 1 and 4 carry the filer's '(IN-KIND)' marker and total 1,240.00; monetary-only gives 1,456.80 and fails by 1,240.00. The two in-kind gifts on Schedule A are entered a second time here as offsetting expenditures of the identical date and amount (the ADDENDUM G1 'Voeks' pattern), and both stated Column A figures include them. Column B YTD 12,161.17 is retained as cumulative and never summed.

itemized.in_kind_convention: MONETARY-PLUS-IN-KIND on both sides — tested both ways per ADDENDUM G1. Contributions: monetary-only 500.00 vs stated 1,740.00 (fails); monetary+in-kind 1,740.00 (closes). Expenditures: monetary-only 1,456.80 vs stated 2,696.80 (fails); monetary+in-kind 2,696.80 (closes). The filer wrote '(IN-KIND)' in the AMOUNT column on the wrap line above the two affected rows on each schedule, and double-entered each gift as a contribution and an equal offsetting expenditure.
itemized.escalation_note: The two 120.00 amount cells (Schedule A row 1 and Schedule B row 1) were escalated to a 900 dpi tight cell crop because the filer's '2' is a rounded open glyph that could read as a '6'. Both were settled by UNIQUE ARITHMETIC CLOSURE (120 + 250 + 250 + 1120 = 1,740.00, the printed subtotal; 126 would give 1,746.00) AND by the filer's own comparison glyph on the SAME row — the Name/Nature cell of each row reads '(120 SIGN LEGS)' with the identical rounded glyph, and his date cells 'JUNE 26, 2018' / 'JUN 23, 2018' write the same character. Arithmetic closure outranks glyph reading (GOTCHAS / Rhodes reversal); the glyph comparison only confirms it.

itemized.notes: Thomas V. Sakievich, Utah County Commission Seat A, 2018 cycle. PAGE-FACE CANDIDATE NAME IS 'THOMAS V. SAKIEVICH' while index.csv names NO candidate at all (the channel label is the reporting-period string 'Out at Primary - Sakievich'); the page face governs and the coordinator may promote it. Report type: '30 Days after the Primary Election (if eliminated at the Primary)', amendment = No (the 'No' box is ticked), signed July 25, 2018. Office Seeking is written on the page as 'UTAH COUNTY COMMISSION, SEAT A' — the seat is PRINTED here, not inferred. Party written REPUBLICAN. Single report, no bundle. FORM SHAPE — worth recording: the SUMMARY PAGE IS BOUND LAST (p4) on this legacy_colAB filing, not p2; the order is p1 cover / p2 SCHEDULE A / p3 SCHEDULE B / p4 SUMMARY PAGE, and every page was classified from its own printed heading (ADDENDUM H6). No checklist decoy page is present. STOCK: the cover is the COUNTY-ONLY blank titled 'FINANCIAL CAMPAIGN REPORT FOR COUNTY CANDIDATES' (Utah County Code 2-5 & Utah State Code 17-16-6.5) with a vertical rail reading 'County & Local School Candidates', while all three inner sheets are strap-lined '2016 County & Local School Board Candidates' — leftover 2016 stock used for a genuinely 2018 filing (utah-template-vintage-year; ADDENDUM H2 named this filing correctly, and reading the headings confirmed it). Each inner sheet foliates itself 'Page 1 of 1'. Schedule B's column is headed 'Name/Nature of Expenditure'. THE FILER'S OWN CONVENTION, stated once here because it drives every field assignment: he writes each entry across TWO lines within one band — the upper (wrap) line carries the in-kind marker, the nature/purpose and the CITY/STATE/ZIP, and the ruled line carries the date, the name and the street. That is why city/state come from the line ABOVE the street on rows 2-4 of Schedule A. Both sides reconcile EXACTLY to the promoted per-period Column A figure, and only with in-kind included.
